pages.body: ## Rust native API migration The 0.431.0 minor release includes native Rust API additions. Complete `NativeSfcCompileOptions` struct literals need `scope_id: None` to retain the filename-derived scope identity, or `Some("data-v-...")` for an explicit identity. Callers using `..NativeSfcCompileOptions::default()` already receive `None`. Exhaustive matches on `NativeSfcCompileError` and the lowering enum `UnsupportedReason` must handle their new refusal variants. The native pipeline remains experimental and opt-in. This release does not claim that native product migration or the product fix-history gates are complete. ## Community lint improvements - `vue/prefer-props-shorthand` now reports and fixes same-name bindings on native elements as well as components, including `:style="style"` and `:aria-label="ariaLabel"` ([#7417](https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/issues/7417)). - The opt-in `type/strict-boolean-expressions` rule checks non-boolean conditions in scripts and templates ([#7377](https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/issues/7377)). - Cross-file lint detects attributes passed to a component whose root cannot receive fallthrough attributes ([#7273](https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/issues/7273)). Thank you [@naitokosuke](https://github.com/naitokosuke) for these reports and proposals. ## Vapor static attributes `compileVapor` preserves nested character references and quoted values in static attributes when HTML templates are parsed at runtime or rendered from the IR on the server ([#7502](https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/issues/7502)). Implicit default content beside a named slot template is also retained in the Vapor IR and generated slot functions ([#7570](https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/issues/7570)). Static style values are retained beside `:style` in whitespace-preserve and parser-recovery compilation, including the public `transform_to_ir` API ([#7600](https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/issues/7600)). Thank you [@dannote](https://github.com/dannote) for these reproductions. ## Drop-in scope `@vizejs/vite-plugin` is a drop-in replacement for `@vitejs/plugin-vue` on **Vue 3 SFCs** (`

pages.body:
## Drop-in scope

`@vizejs/vite-plugin` is a drop-in replacement for `@vitejs/plugin-vue` on **Vue 3 SFCs**
(`<script setup>` and Options API). Vue 2 / 2.7 (`vue.version: "2"` / `"2.7"`) is
incubating and opt-in, webpack / rollup / esbuild / Rspack are outside the drop-in claim
(`@vizejs/unplugin` and `@vizejs/rspack-plugin` are experimental), and plugin-option
parity with `@vitejs/plugin-vue` is still incomplete.

See [Drop-in Scope](https://vizejs.dev/guide/vite-plugin#drop-in-scope) and
[#3227](https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/issues/3227).


## What's Changed
* fix(release): recover SDK publication from promoted candidates by @ubugeeei in https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/pull/6896
* fix(ssr): derive slot scope ids from scoped slotted styles by @ubugeeei in https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/pull/6903
* fix(nuxt): restore SSR critical CSS collection by @ubugeeei in https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/pull/6904
* fix(ssr): preserve public option struct compatibility by @ubugeeei in https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/pull/6908
* chore(release): v0.429.1 by @ubugeeei in https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/pull/6909


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/compare/v0.429.0...v0.429.1

## Drop-in scope

parity with `@vitejs/plugin-vue` is still incomplete.

[#3227](https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/issues/3227).

pages.body:
## Drop-in scope

`@vizejs/vite-plugin` is a drop-in replacement for `@vitejs/plugin-vue` on **Vue 3 SFCs**
(`<script setup>` and Options API). Vue 2 / 2.7 (`vue.version: "2"` / `"2.7"`) is
incubating and opt-in, webpack / rollup / esbuild / Rspack are outside the drop-in claim
(`@vizejs/unplugin` and `@vizejs/rspack-plugin` are experimental), and plugin-option
parity with `@vitejs/plugin-vue` is still incomplete.

See [Drop-in Scope](https://vizejs.dev/guide/vite-plugin#drop-in-scope) and
[#3227](https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/issues/3227).

## Drop-in scope

`@vizejs/vite-plugin` is a drop-in replacement for `@vitejs/plugin-vue` on **Vue 3 SFCs**
(`<script setup>` and Options API). Vue 2 / 2.7 (`vue.version: "2"` / `"2.7"`) is
incubating and opt-in, webpack / rollup / esbuild / Rspack are outside the drop-in claim
(`@vizejs/unplugin` and `@vizejs/rspack-plugin` are experimental), and plugin-option
parity with `@vitejs/plugin-vue` is still incomplete.

See [Drop-in Scope](https://vizejs.dev/guide/vite-plugin#drop-in-scope) and
[#3227](https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/issues/3227).

pages.body:
## Drop-in scope

`@vizejs/vite-plugin` is a drop-in replacement for `@vitejs/plugin-vue` on **Vue 3 SFCs**
(`<script setup>` and Options API). Vue 2 / 2.7 (`vue.version: "2"` / `"2.7"`) is
incubating and opt-in, webpack / rollup / esbuild / Rspack are outside the drop-in claim
(`@vizejs/unplugin` and `@vizejs/rspack-plugin` are experimental), and plugin-option
parity with `@vitejs/plugin-vue` is still incomplete.

See [Drop-in Scope](https://vizejs.dev/guide/vite-plugin#drop-in-scope) and
[#3227](https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/issues/3227).


## What's Changed
* docs(davinci): record P2-11 style merge installment by @ubugeeei in https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/pull/4799

## Drop-in scope

`@vizejs/vite-plugin` is a drop-in replacement for `@vitejs/plugin-vue` on **Vue 3 SFCs**
(`<script setup>` and Options API). Vue 2 / 2.7 (`vue.version: "2"` / `"2.7"`) is

parity with `@vitejs/plugin-vue` is still incomplete.

[#3227](https://github.com/ubugeeei-prod/vize/issues/3227).

head_commit.message:
feat(config): share Vite settings across CLI and language server (#8392)

* feat(cli): initialize projects without dedicated Vize config

* feat(config): share Vite project settings across native tools

* test(config): exercise config-free CLI and LSP project settings

* fix(config): preserve older adapter installations and typed defaults

* test(config): compare public LSP URI as a string

* fix(config): preserve formatter payloads and scope checker defaults

* refactor(lsp): extract shared formatter option conversion

* fix(config): preserve disabled editor capabilities and source types

* test(config): retain complete public tool output oracles

* fix(config): include shared Vite runtime in Nix CLI sources

* test(config): declare fresh Zed formatting policy successor

* fix(config): preserve explicit missing-file diagnostics

* fix(lsp): preserve malformed dedicated config defaults

* refactor(test): move complete LSP capability oracle

* test(lsp): pin fresh project capability policy

* test(lsp): retain local capability policy observations

* docs(config): retain JSX opt-out recipe within source budgets

* test(lsp): bind fresh JSX defaults to receipted source executable

* fix(lsp): accept config-free editor directories at the owning layer

* fix(lsp): preserve authored Vite formatter whitespace

* test(lsp): retain the authored template range endpoint

* test(init): preserve archived plans for config-free release setup

* test(release): retain historical audit in config-free successor

* test(cli): preserve Yarn checkJs in config-free initialization

* fix(config): preserve Vite environments and checker-only execution

* fix(release): qualify config-free initializer snapshots

The installed TS/JS prelude read vize.config.ts before the fresh-project matrix,
so a config-free initializer failed before its diagnostic checks could run.
Snapshot package.json and tsconfig.json and reuse the existing dedicated-config
absence check after both initialization passes without changing the helper API,
authored sources, manager argv, or diagnostic flow.

Retain the entire original helper and runtime-oracle sources. Preserve the
historical false-clean CLI literal and derive its current fixture by removing
only the dedicated-config write. Add bounded absence, idempotency, and complete
source inverse controls and record the declared capability successor.

Validation: 20 pure Node fixture/control tests, focused Oxfmt check, focused
Oxlint with warnings denied, and git diff --check pass. Genuine Rust packed
runtime and exact-source Actions remain required after inclusion.

* docs(config): keep packed init decision within canonical row ceiling

The initializer closure appended its own decision as a two-row suffix, taking
the canonical record from 350 to 352 rows. Relocate the identical decision text
into the existing config-free packed initializer row using one inline space.
Preserve the entire original suffix and canonical bytes in private custody.

Removing the inline literal restores the entire original 277f canonical record.
All seven source, test, archive, and companion-document blobs and modes remain
unchanged from 50c. This is a record-only ceiling correction.

Validation: whole-byte inverse, 350-row count, unchanged mode/object inventory,
and git diff --check. No runtime, installs, CI dispatch, or remote mutation.

* test(config): place discovery refusal under native source ownership

Move only the appended default-discovery missing-import test out of the tooling
runner for unchanged restoration by the checked native owner. Retain the whole
old runner and exact complete test block in private source custody, including
the exit-two requirement and full diagnostics. All six preceding cases remain
byte-exact; product behavior and expected outcomes do not change.

Compare the additive no-authored-formatting fixture with the entire original
settings minus only the authored formatting switch. Preserve all original
fixtures and editor response oracles, and record the bounded execution-owner
correction within the existing 350-row canonical record.

Validation: exact whole-file inverses and unchanged fixture/mode inventories,
focused Oxfmt/Oxlint, Rustfmt 1.99 with edition 2024, and git diff --check. Old
whole raw failures remain authority. No product runtime, Cargo, CI dispatch or
remote mutation; fresh exact-source Actions remain required after composition.

* fix(ci): build config provider before Musea consumers

* fix(ci): include rule-type generation prerequisite in core
